courses.synopsis: Atomic and crystal structure. Metallic states. Defect in crystals, conductors, semi-conductors, insulators and super-conductors. The relationship between structure and properties. Alloy theory-application to industrial alloys – steel in particular. Simple phase diagram of alloys. Engineering properties – thermal control, hot and cold working, heat treatment, etc. Creep, fatigue and fracture. Corrosion and corrosion control. Non-metallic materials – glass, rubber, concrete, plastics, wood and ceramics. Elastic and plastic deformations. Materials for cryogenic, corrosive media and nuclear Applications.
